title: Tim, 29
body: Professional trust faller. Looking for someone to catch me (78.5% success rate preferred). 2,847 falls and counting. Small Kevin need not apply. I will explain The Incident if we match. Maybe. If you earn my trust. By catching me.
summary: Professional trust faller. 2,847 falls and counting. 78.5% catch rate.

prompts.question: My ideal first date involves...
prompts.answer: A controlled trust exercise in a padded environment. Bring athletic shoes and sign this waiver.

prompts.question: The most spontaneous thing I've done...
prompts.answer: Fell backwards at a corn festival. Into a corn maze. Got caught by a scarecrow. Counted it.

prompts.question: I'm known for...
prompts.answer: My trust fall statistics spreadsheet. Also my podcast: 'Falling Forward, Landing Backward.' 12 listeners and growing!
